hero.title: ArcGIS Pro
hero.subtitle: ArcGIS Pro brings advanced 2D & 3D mapping, analysis, and data management to your desktop.

intro.paragraph: Part of the Esri Geospatial Cloud, ArcGIS Pro is Esri's powerful, single desktop GIS application. Technologically ahead of everything else on the market, ArcGIS Pro supports data visualization, advanced analysis and authoritative data maintenance in both 2D and 3D. ArcGIS Pro is tightly coupled with the ArcGIS platform supporting data sharing across ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise through Web GIS.

stories.title: See ArcGIS Pro in action
stories.description: Discover how organizations around the world are using ArcGIS Pro to solve complex spatial problems and drive innovation.

items.title: Cartography and Visualization
items.description: Work with intuitive and intelligent cartography tools at any map scale to create amazing 2D and 3D maps for print, apps, dashboards, and the web.

items.title: Analytics and Data Science
items.description: Discover the world around you. Use scientific analytical tools on 2D, 3D, and real-time data to identify patterns, make predictions, and answer questions.

items.title: Automation
items.description: Improve the efficiency and accuracy of your tasks, workflows, and analysis with automation tools.

items.title: Data Management
items.description: Ensure data integrity and accuracy with a complete set of tools for storing, editing, evaluating, and managing all kinds of spatial data—including real-time and big data.

items.title: Imagery
items.description: Drones, satellites, aerial, video, lidar, and more, ArcGIS Pro provides powerful tools to manage and analyze imagery.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
items.description: Blend IoT data, GIS-driven location intelligence, and artificial intelligence (AI)-powered algorithms and deep learning models to drive insight, establishing patterns and relationships, and make smarter decisions.

items.title: Administration
items.description: Deploy ArcGIS Pro across your organization using tools that are secure and scalable in either physical or virtual machines.

items.title: Customize and Extend
items.description: Extend and tailor ArcGIS Pro with add-ins and configurations developed with the ArcGIS Pro SDK for .NET.

steps.title: Integrate data from multiple sources
steps.desc: Combine data from various sources and formats. ArcGIS Pro supports industry and community standards to ensure inclusion of any dataset you have.

steps.title: Visualize your data
steps.desc: Display data in 2D and 3D simultaneously. Manage multiple maps and layouts in a single project-based workflow.

steps.title: Edit and analyze your data
steps.desc: Simplify data editing and analysis with context-sensitive tools. Perform interactive 2D and 3D analysis. Automate work with ModelBuilder or Python.ing.

steps.title: Share your work with the world
steps.desc: Publish maps and analysis results as web services or high-quality prints. Share maps and data on ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise or as a package.

success.title: Advanced Desktop GIS
success.desc: Experience the power of ArcGIS Pro through interactive demos and real-world applications.
